claims.evidence: Run names SILAC_E2_<6|36>hrs_rep<1-3>_Frc<NN>-<1|2>.RAW; MaxQuant experimentalDesignTemplate maps rep1/2/3 to experiments A/B/C for both time points. Paper: light (ethanol control) and heavy (estradiol) cells, three biological replicates per time point, equimolar heavy+light lysates mixed per replicate. One source = one labelled culture (one treatment, one time point, one replicate); the light and heavy culture of a mixture are different physical samples.

claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[treatment] + factor value[treatment] + characteristics[dose] rows 1-432
claims.value: SILAC light = untreated (vehicle 0.1% ethanol), dose not applicable; SILAC heavy = estradiol, 10 nM
claims.evidence: Paper Cell Labeling by SILAC: "the media of heavy cells was replaced with RPMI 1640 with 10% dextran-coated charcoal-treated FBS and 10 nM 17beta-estradiol ... whereas the media of control light cells contained RPMI 1640, 10% dextran-coated charcoal-treated FBS and 0.1% ethanol"; PRIDE protocol: "Heavy isotope-labeled cells were treated with 10 nM estradiol (Sigma), while control cells were treated with 0.1% ethanol". Data check (log2 H/L normalized, reps A/B/C): 36 h TFF1 +2.25/+2.07/+2.21, GREB1 +2.19/+2.11/+2.15, PGR +1.64/+1.63/+1.80, CTSD +0.56/+0.49/+0.55, ESR1 -1.28/-1.22/-1.20 (ligand-induced ERalpha down-regulation); 6 h TFF1 +0.71/+0.76/+0.68, ESR1 -0.95/-0.91/-0.52 -> heavy = estradiol-treated, consistent with the paper (TFF1 immediate early). No conflict. Treatment NCIT:C2295 Estradiol (OLS); control = untreated (campaign rule 4, template-prescribed; validate-sdrf warns it is not an NCIT/EFO term).

claims.location: characteristics[sampling time] + factor value[sampling time] rows 1-432
claims.evidence: Paper/PRIDE: "Cells were grown for 6 or 36 h"; separate MaxQuant searches MaxQuant_results_6h / _36h and run names 6hrs / 36hrs. Both channels of a mixture share the time point.

Paper: cells seeded "in triplicates"; "Three biological replicates of ~3x10^6 cells (500 ug of total protein)"; MaxQuant experiments A/B/C = rep1/2/3. Each number is one independent culture per labelled condition; light rep1 and heavy rep1 are different cultures paired in one mixture (numbers restart per factor-value group, campaign rule 3).

Every SCX fraction was deposited as two runs suffixed -1 and -2; MaxQuant experimentalDesignTemplate gives both the same Slice (fraction) and the same Experiment, and the raw headers of Frc22-1 and Frc22-2 show the identical 60-min method (60min_ms1_60K-6LTQms2-Xcal-0_4eq.meth). Interpreted as two LC-MS/MS injections of the same fraction (inference; see limitations).

limitations: Not pulsed SILAC: despite the campaign hint, this is a standard 2-plex SILAC design (heavy = 10 nM estradiol, light = 0.1% ethanol vehicle) at two time points (6 h, 36 h), 3 biological replicates each, 18 SCX fractions, 2 injections per fraction. SRM experiments described in the paper are not part of this deposit.

comment[technical replicate]: the -1/-2 suffix meaning is not stated in the paper or PRIDE; interpreted as duplicate injections of the same SCX fraction because MaxQuant assigns both to the same Slice/Experiment and the raw files use the identical method.
Control rows use characteristics[treatment] = untreated per campaign rule 4; the controls actually received vehicle (0.1% ethanol). No separate vehicle column is asserted.
comment[precursor mass tolerance] 20 ppm comes from the paper/PRIDE text; MaxQuant 1.1.1.25 parameters.txt lists only the first-search tolerance (7 ppm) and no mqpar.xml was deposited.

Paper says "1 missed cleavage" and "minimum peptide length of 7"; deposited summary.txt/parameters.txt say max 2 missed cleavages and min length 6. Not encoded in the SDRF (no column); recorded here. PRIDE data protocol text says "SILAC double measurements of Lys6 and Arg8" whereas the paper says Lys8 and Arg6 and MaxQuant summary.txt says Arg6;Lys8 with heavy L-13C6-arginine/L-13C6,15N2-lysine; the search output and paper win.
characteristics[cell type], characteristics[passage number] = not available: not stated.

Paper full text was read from the PMC HTML page (pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov); Europe PMC fullTextXML returned 500 and the Unpaywall/Europe PMC PDF returned 403 (not bypassed). Supplementary tables were not consulted; the channel map rests on explicit Methods text plus deposited ratios.
